name: Mat'Selesnya
description: The Worldsoul of Ravnica whose power Oba draws on.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
timeline.quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

pages_say.description: The founder of Selesnya whose will Trostani voices.
The Selesnya voice who told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to recover.
The Worldsoul of Ravnica whose power Oba draws on.
